full_judgment: 36. Our considered view is that, the Appellate Court on misconception of law, and misreading and wrong appreciation of evidence on record committed error of law resulting in erroneous decision occasioning failure of justice in allowing the appeal and decreeing the suit, and the High Court Division while sat on judgment of reversal, totally failed to appreciate evidence on record in order to arrive at its own independent decision, as such, was wrong in affirming the same by discharging the Rule.
